record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare WOOD_HAMMER: Bonsley (1 star, base ATK 9) and Sudowoodo (2 stars, base ATK 22), both maxPP 100, range 1, passive SUDOWOODO. The strategy is shared; the multiplier table is indexed by stars and the damage is proportional to the caster's ATK at cast time.
record.summary: At cast time the caster's current ATK is read; 500 ms later the cast target takes SPECIAL damage of (multiplier x that ATK), where the multiplier is 4 for 1 and 2 stars (8 for 3, 16 for 4), and then, unless the caster holds Protective Pads, the caster takes PHYSICAL recoil equal to that same ATK (no AP, no crit). The damage step uses default AP scaling and the cast's crit flag; the recoil does not. Both amounts are requests resolved by handleSpecialDamage / handleDamage.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target (the unit the caster is attacking when the cast fires, captured at cast time); recoil: the caster itself
targeting.note: requiresTarget is true (default). The target is captured in the closure at cast time, so if the cast target dies during the 500 ms the delayed hit goes to a unit with hp <= 0 and is ignored (handleDamage returns takenDamage 0), while the recoil still runs. Which unit is the cast target comes from generic targeting, not read.

declaredRaw.label: requested ATK multiplier (raw); requested damage = multiplier x caster ATK at cast time

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] x pokemon.atk (ATK read at cast time, including any bonuses present then; example at base ATK: Bonsley 4 x 9 = 36, Sudowoodo 4 x 22 = 88). handleSpecialDamage (default apBoost true): x (1 + AP/100); x2 once if the caster has DOUBLE_DAMAGE (removed on use); x1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT on either side; x critPower (reduced by Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite on the target) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT). The ATK is NOT re-read at fire time.
effects.resolution: applied = the figure handed to PokemonState.handleDamage after 500 ms. handleDamage then divides SPECIAL damage by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the target's shield absorbs first. takenDamage reported (not used by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current hp; it is 0 if the target has protect / skydiving / magicBounce (blocked entirely; magicBounce may reflect) or if it has hp <= 0 or is resurrecting when the command fires.

effects.scaling: requested = pokemon.atk at cast time (base ATK shown; raw is not multiplied by the table). Called with crit false and apBoost false, so no AP and no crit scaling; the DOUBLE_DAMAGE check can still double it if the target hit did not consume the flag (it normally does, because the hit runs first). Skipped entirely if the caster holds Protective Pads when the command fires.
effects.resolution: applied = handleSpecialDamage on the caster with attacker = the caster: blocked (0) if the caster itself has protect / skydiving / magicBounce; otherwise handleDamage divides PHYSICAL damage by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x def of the caster), rounds up with a minimum of 1, and the caster's own shield absorbs first. It can kill the caster. Requested vs applied: the recoil is a request equal to ATK, the HP actually lost is reduced by the caster's DEF, never below 1 unless blocked or capped by remaining hp.

starBehavior.note: The table has four entries (4, 4, 8, 16); 1 and 2 stars both use 4, so the difference between the listed units comes from their ATK. The 3-star (8) and 4-star (16, also the ?? fallback) columns are not reachable by the bare factory star counts of the listed units. Recoil does not depend on stars.

record.positionalConditions: None in the strategy itself; range 1 (melee) comes from the unit blocks.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP PP (floor 0) and queues one 500 ms command on the caster; the ATK is sampled once per cast. The SUDOWOODO passive (adds ATK each second while status.tree is on) changes the ATK later casts read, but that mechanic is not part of this record.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage = 4 x caster ATK (SPECIAL) on the target and recoil = caster ATK (PHYSICAL) on the caster, both sampled at cast time (base ATK: Bonsley 36 / 9, Sudowoodo 88 / 22). Applied damage = requested x (1 + AP/100) x optional DOUBLE_DAMAGE / steam / crit multipliers, reduced by the target's SPE_DEF with a minimum of 1, shield first, and 0 if blocked or if the target is already dead or resurrecting when the command fires. Applied recoil = ATK reduced by the caster's own DEF with a minimum of 1, shield first, skipped under Protective Pads, blocked by the caster's own protect / skydiving / magicBounce. takenDamage includes shield damage.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Which unit is the cast target and when the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, targeting) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Whether the caster's pending command runs after the caster dies in the 500 ms window (PokemonState.update calls updateCommands each tick, but how dead entities are updated was not read)
Item and ATK modifiers that make pokemon.atk differ from base ATK at cast time (the stat adders were not traced for this record)
Damage resolution after handleDamage's earlier branches (flat reductions, Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band) was not traced for the hit or the recoil
unresolved: pokemon.atk at cast time can include item, synergy and passive bonuses (the SUDOWOODO passive adds +1 / +2 ATK per second while in tree status); the numeric examples are at base ATK only
If the caster dies from the recoil or earlier, effects keyed to the caster's death were not traced
Cover Band can redirect part of handleDamage to an ally; the hit's returned death flag is not used by this strategy

magicBounce on the cast target can reflect the SPECIAL hit back (500 ms later) to the caster (read in handleSpecialDamage, not simulated); Protective Pads on the caster prevents that bounce and the recoil
Whether the two units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
